delta_fraction_rule: delta visibility fraction = signed delta_*_h / delta_fraction_denominator_h; multiply by 100 for percentage points. Exact integer rational, not rounded input-array subtraction.
out_of_range_rule: Require every hourly cell of the original and shifted stay; do not clamp or shorten. Full final 23:00 cell is included; end-exclusive 2031-01-01T00:00Z is allowed.
dark_censor_rule: Within-stay run lengths. A dark edge is censored when the adjacent out-of-stay cell is dark, or that adjacent cell is outside the ephemeris.
